title: Crews of Lancaster 4103 and Oxford LB415
memorial_details:
description: Brass plaque:  In memory of/ the crews of two Royal Air Force aircraft/ who lost their lives in the mid-air collision/ above Screveton at 16.30 hours on Friday April 14th 1944/ Avro Lancaster Mark I serial number W4103/ of/ No 5 Lancaster finishing school./ NO 5 Group/ Royal Air Force Bomber Command/ Royal Air Force Syerston/ Nottinghamshire./ (Names)/ Airspeed Oxford Mark I Serial Number LB415/ No 93 Operational Training Unit/ No.7 Group/Royal Air Force Bomber Command/ Royal Air Force Wymeswold/ Leicestershire./ (Names)
Paper memorial:  similar to plaque, but minor differences describing No 93 OTU and mispelling of names (see image)
